environment.organisation: QA-GEO (org_id dcea498b-a5cc-4c2a-b078-82530de16998), role SUPER_ADMIN, existing session (no login needed)
environment.featureFlag: unbranded_analysis = true: 5-step wizard, Brand analysis card + Continue used for every wizard
environment.pool: P = 1000; U = 703 at start and at end (7 analyses both times)
environment.stateChanges: None. No analysis created, no back-office action, no deletion, no Manage Scope save. Wizards ended with Back to Dashboard > Exit and Discard. Toyota country filter reset to All Countries.

sideFindings: Stepper "Brand & Country" clicked from the Prompts step (after unticks or custom prompts) opens "Exit setup?" (wizard.discardModal.title) with "Your analysis configuration for {brand} is incomplete. Exiting the process now will result in the loss of all progress made during this session." (wizard.discardModal.stepChangesDescription); "Exit and Discard" (wizard.common.exitAndDiscard) does not exit: the user stays in the wizard on Brand & Country with brand and markets kept. The copy says exit and loss of all progress, the behaviour is a step change. Seen twice (Nike, Decathlon). Same pattern as Review > Categories in the GEO-1237 run.

Remove category dialog: "Are you sure you want to remove Outdoor Gear ? This action cannot be undone." has a space before "?" (wizard.deleteCategory.description = "... {{name}} ? ..."); and "60 prompts across your markets will be deleted with it." (wizard.deleteCategory.impact_other) was shown after France had been removed, with only GB (EN) left (30 expected for the remaining market; 60 = count of the previous GB + FR prompt set).

Dashboard country filter aria-label reads "Country filter — 1 selected" / "— 2 selected" while the key is "Country filter — {{market}} selected" (dashboard.market.ariaSelected): a count is passed instead of the market name(s).

Dashboard country filter: with "All Countries" active every country is ticked; clicking "United States" unticks it (result "France - Spain") instead of selecting it alone. Selecting one country needs the others unticked. The selection persists across a reload.

AI Sense translation of the custom category "Football boots": FR "Bottes de football" (literal; usual term "Chaussures de football" / "Crampons"), US (EN) "Soccer Cleats", ES "Tacos de fútbol". Data quality only.
Wizard pool popover opens on hover only (data-state delayed-open); clicking the ring does not open it (keyboard / touch access to be confirmed).
proposedCsvChanges: TC-GEO-1229-001 step 2 Test data: replace the example "Decathlon" (already used twice in QA-GEO) by a brand not used in T, e.g. "Nike".

TC-GEO-1229-001 step 4 Test data: "Running shoes" duplicates the AI category "Running Shoes" usually detected for sports brands and is refused as "This category already exists."; use extra categories that cannot collide and add enough to reach 6 when discovery returns 2 (e.g. "Cycling", "Camping", "Basketball", "Football boots").

TC-GEO-1229-001 steps 5-6: state that with 6 categories x 4 markets the selection (760) is over the pool, so the user unticks prompts (e.g. 3 markets via the market filter and the header checkbox) until U + S <= P, then checks that Review & Launch is enabled.
TC-GEO-1229-003 step 3: name the popover parts as shown: "Kept in this analysis" reads 37 (and "In use by other analyses" reads U); the popover opens on hover of the ring.
TC-GEO-1229-003 precondition: when the minimal scope is reached from a wider wizard, custom prompts of the kept market and category are carried over; delete them to get 40.
TC-GEO-1229-004 step 4 expected: use the real label: "In use by other analyses" = U - S.

TC-GEO-1229-007 step 3: "the user ticks only United States (unticks the other countries)" - with All Countries active a click on United States unticks it. Precondition: no analysis M with United States EN + ES exists in QA-GEO; it must be created in a dedicated run.

results.title: Keeping prompts across brands, categories and markets only decreases the shared pool

steps.title: Given the user is on the GEO dashboard of organisation T
steps.expected: The pool block reads "U / P"

steps.title: When the user starts a new analysis for a brand that no analysis of the organisation uses yet
steps.data: Brand: a brand not used yet in T (e.g. "Decathlon")
steps.expected: Brand & Country accepts the brand with no brand quota message

steps.title: And the user adds 4 markets including one country in two languages
steps.data: United Kingdom - English (EN), France - French (FR), United States - English (EN), United States - Spanish (ES)
steps.expected: The 4 market rows are added with no country, language or market limit message

steps.title: And the user keeps every detected category and adds categories until there are at least 6
steps.expected: Every category is added with no category limit message

steps.title: And the user opens the Prompts step
steps.expected: The toolbar ring reads "U + S / P", S being the number of ticked prompts of this analysis

steps.title: Then no per-brand, per-category, per-country or per-language cap blocks the selection
steps.expected: The only limit shown is the pool ring; Review & Launch is enabled while U + S <= P

results.notes: Dashboard pool block "703 / 1000 prompts" (U = 703, P = 1000, 7 analyses). Brand used: Nike (nike.com), because Decathlon is already used by 2 analyses of QA-GEO (the CSV example no longer meets "a brand not used yet"). Brand & Country: brand accepted, no brand quota message. 4 markets added: United Kingdom - English (EN), France - French (FR), United States - English (EN), United States - Spanish (ES) (language changed to Spanish (ES) on the second US row); no country, language or market limit message, Add country still available. Categories: discovery returned Running Shoes + Athletic Apparel; "Running shoes" refused only as a duplicate ("This category already exists.", views.addCategory.alreadyExists), not as a limit; Cycling, Camping, Basketball, Football Boots added = 6 categories, no limit message (helper "Categories are unlimited and set by you, never derived from results.", wizard.category.infoTitle). Prompts: 760 rows ticked (6 categories x 4 markets x 30 + 4 x 10 Brand Image), ring "1463 / 1000 prompts · 760 selected" = U + S / P, message "463 prompts over. Untick prompts or contact your account manager." (wizard.pool.overWizard_other), Review & Launch disabled. Page text searched for limit / quota / maximum / cap / upgrade / higher plan: nothing found. Then market filter FR (FR) + US (EN) + US (ES) and header checkbox "Tick or untick every prompt": ring "893 / 1000 prompts · 190 selected", over message gone, Review & Launch enabled. The only limit shown is the pool ring. Extra screenshots: step2b (6 categories), step2c (ring over the pool).
results.description: Verify that prompts kept in any analysis draw on the single organisation pool and that no per-brand, per-category, per-country or per-language cap blocks the user, even beyond the old per-type, Countries and Categories max quotas. Covers AC-1.

results.title: The same prompt kept in two markets consumes two slots

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step of an analysis with markets GB (EN) and FR (FR)
steps.expected: The toolbar ring reads "X / P" (X = U + ticked prompts of this analysis)

steps.title: When the user adds a custom prompt in market GB (EN)
steps.data: Prompt: "Which brand sells the best trail running shoes?" - Category C1 - Type Visibility - Market GB (EN)
steps.expected: The row is added ticked and the ring reads "X + 1 / P"

steps.title: And the user adds the same prompt in market FR (FR)
steps.data: Same text, Category C1, Type Visibility, Market FR (FR)
steps.expected: The row is accepted (same text in another market is not a duplicate) and the ring reads "X + 2 / P"

steps.title: Then the prompt kept in two markets consumes two slots
steps.expected: "N selected" and the ring both increased by 2 for the two rows

results.notes: Scope: Decathlon (decathlon.com), GB (EN) + FR (FR), C1 = Sporting Goods, C2 = Outdoor Gear (discovery returned exactly these 2) = 140 rows. Ring "843 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected" (X = 843 = U + 140). Custom prompt "Which brand sells the best trail running shoes?", Sporting Goods, Visibility, GB (EN): row added ticked (CUSTOM tag), toast "Prompt added. It uses one pool slot." (wizard.promptTable.promptAdded), ring "844 / 1000 · 141 selected". Same text, Sporting Goods, Visibility, FR (FR): accepted with no duplicate message (wizard.promptTable.duplicatePrompt not shown), ticked, ring "845 / 1000 · 142 selected". Ring and "N selected" both +2 for the two rows (green frames in step3). The draft row defaults to Category "Other" and Type "Other" (flag ON, GEO-1247). Extra screenshot step2a = after the GB (EN) row.
results.description: Verify that a kept prompt that runs in two markets consumes two pool slots (one ticked prompt in one market = one slot). Covers AC-2.

results.title: An unticked prompt consumes no slot

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step with every suggestion ticked
steps.expected: The ring reads "U + 40 / P" and "40 selected" is shown

steps.title: When the user unticks 3 prompts
steps.expected: The 3 rows are greyed and the ring reads "U + 37 / P"

steps.title: Then the unticked prompts consume no slot
steps.expected: "37 selected" is shown and the popover "this analysis" part reads 37

steps.title: When the user ticks one of them again
steps.expected: The ring reads "U + 38 / P"

results.notes: Minimal scope from the same wizard: France removed on Brand & Country, Outdoor Gear removed on Categories, prompts regenerated (41 rows: the GB custom prompt of TC-002 was carried over and deleted to get the CSV scope) = 40 rows, ring "743 / 1000 prompts · 40 selected" (U + 40). Rows 1-3 (Brand Image, GB (EN)) unticked: text grey rgb(148,163,184) vs rgb(30,41,59) for kept rows, ring "740 / 1000 prompts · 37 selected". Pool popover (opens on hover, data-state delayed-open; a click does not open it): "Prompt pool / 740 of 1000 after creation / In use by other analyses 703 / Kept in this analysis 37 / Free in the pool 260" (wizard.pool.summaryAfterCreation, inUseByOthers, keptHere, free). Row 1 ticked again: ring "741 / 1000 prompts · 38 selected". Extra screenshot step4 = after the re-tick.
results.description: Verify that unticking a prompt frees its slot and ticking it back consumes it again: an unticked prompt consumes none. Covers AC-2.

results.notes: SKIP: state-changing action not allowed (user decision) - the TC deletes an existing analysis (no disposable analysis D allowed). Not executed, no screenshot. results.title: A pool lowered below usage leaves existing prompts and running analyses untouched

steps.title: Given the pool of organisation T was lowered below usage in the back office
steps.expected: The back office saves the new pool with the below-usage warning

steps.title: When the user opens the GEO dashboard of organisation T
steps.expected: Every analysis is still listed with the same Prompts column values; the pool block reads "U / U - 10" in red

steps.title: And the user opens Manage Scope > Prompts of analysis R
steps.expected: Every kept prompt is still listed and ticked; none was removed or unticked

steps.title: Then analysis R keeps collecting
steps.data: Next daily collection after the change
steps.expected: The next run of R is collected with the same prompts and its results are updated

results.notes: SKIP: state-changing action not allowed (user decision) - the TC needs the prompt pool of QA-GEO lowered below usage in the back office (and a later daily collection). Not executed, no screenshot.
results.description: Verify that when the pool is reduced below usage (downgrade or non-renewal), existing prompts and running analyses are untouched. Covers AC-4. Needs setup: back-office admin access to lower the pool of organisation T, and a later collection.

results.title: Over a lowered pool only adding prompts is blocked until the count fits

steps.expected: The edit is saved

steps.expected: The unticks are saved and the ring reads "U - 3 / U - 2"

steps.title: Then adding prompts is possible again once the count fits
steps.expected: Ticking one suggested prompt is accepted and the ring reads "U - 2 / U - 2"

results.notes: SKIP: state-changing action not allowed (user decision) - the TC needs the prompt pool of QA-GEO lowered below usage in the back office, then saved edits and unticks in Manage Scope of an existing analysis. Not executed, no screenshot.
results.description: Verify that after a downgrade below usage only adding prompts is blocked, while unticking, deleting and editing stay possible, and that adding works again once the count fits. Covers AC-4. Needs setup: back-office admin access to lower the pool of organisation T.

results.title: The dashboard market filter lists a country once and rolls up its languages

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of analysis M
steps.expected: The Overview is displayed

steps.title: When the user opens the market (country) filter
steps.expected: The filter lists "United States" once and "France" once (no separate entry per language)

steps.title: And the user selects "United States" only
steps.expected: The filter shows United States selected

steps.title: Then the results roll up both languages of the country
steps.expected: The prompts and results shown include the English and the Spanish prompts of United States, and none of France

results.notes: Prerequisite missing: no analysis of QA-GEO has a country in two languages. GET /geo/api/v1/reports: for all 7 analyses marketCount = number of countryCodes (Decathlon x2 FR,GB; kids toys MA; BYD ES; adidas IN,MA,US; Orange FR,MA; Toyota ES,FR,US). Executed read-only on Toyota 439acd96-0b1b-4da4-9e07-612d38e9783e (markets ES, FR, US). Overview displayed. Country filter (data-testid market-dropdown-trigger) lists "All Countries", "United States", "France", "Spain": one entry per country, but "one entry for a country in two languages" cannot be proven with one language per country. Selecting "United States" only: trigger "United States", aria-label "Country filter — 1 selected". The roll-up of the English and Spanish prompts of United States is not checkable (no such analysis; creating one is not allowed). Filter reset to All Countries at the end (the selection persists across reloads).
results.description: Verify that in an analysis with several country and language pairs, the market filter lists one entry per country and selecting it rolls up all its languages together. Covers AC-5.
